title: queue.rs: DKIM defer comment 'hold for retry' implies transient but signing is deterministic
description: Line 223 in queue.rs says 'If signing fails, defer this article (hold for retry on next cycle).' This comment implies DKIM failure is transient. Ed25519 signing with a fixed key is deterministic — a signing error is always permanent (corrupt key, library bug, OOM). A contributor reading this will implement similar defer-on-failure logic elsewhere assuming it eventually recovers. The comment should say: 'Signing failure is treated as permanent; article is held in queue for operator intervention (no dead-letter path in NntpQueue).' This also documents the known gap.
